dedupe_keys.name: case study result data set for energy economics article demystifying market clearing and price setting effects in low carbon energy systems

description: A Fraunhofer IEE researcher publishes six CSV files of European country-level generation and electricity-consumption time series from a low-carbon market study. Zenodo supplies them under CC BY 4.0. Files separate generation and consumption for conservative, moderate and progressive base-case scenarios. The metadata lists generators, storage, electric vehicles, heat pumps, power-to-gas and industry heat loads, with country codes and mean MW values for each interval. These outputs can benchmark sector-coupled electricity-market and flexibility simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this scenario-series release. Coverage is the modelled European system and its scenario categories, not observed dispatch in every country. A limitation is that the public summary does not state the interval duration or full model inputs; power series should not be read as national-meter data. The six CSV files were not downloaded and no energy balance was recalculated.
